description:
Smart. Focused. Email.

Fast, cross-platform email designed to filter out the noise - so you can focus on what's important.
Introducing Spark Autopilot!
Automate your inbox in plain words. Pick from ready-made suggestions or describe what you want, like "archive my newsletters" or "forward invoices to my accountant," and Spark builds the automation for you.

Before anything goes live, Autopilot shows you exactly which emails it will act on.
Once it's running, you can see what it has handled and pause, edit, or turn it off anytime.
Every edit is re-tested before it's applied, so your automations keep working the way you intended.

Give it a try and share your feedback with us at support@sparkmailapp.com

P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.32.0.141284/Spark.exe
